_meta.holidayNote: No Korean statutory public holiday falls between 2026-11-30 and 2026-12-06. The next one is Christmas Day, Fri 2026-12-25.

yennaljip-hongdae.notes: Naver Place lists the same hours Mon-Sun, closes past midnight (03:30 next day), last order 03:00, no regular or upcoming irregular closed days. No break time. Phone 0507-1346-9608.

myeongdong-kyoja.text: Daily 10:30-21:00, last order 20:30 (open year-round except Seollal/Chuseok)
myeongdong-kyoja.closedDays: Seollal and Chuseok days (not in trip window)
myeongdong-kyoja.notes: Closing is 21:00 (not 21:30); last order 20:30. Hours themselves agree across VisitSeoul/VisitKorea/Naver. Marked unverified because of the ADDRESS: on Naver, '명동교자 본점' is now listed at 129 Toegye-ro (퇴계로 129), while the 29 Myeongdong 10-gil listing shows every day as 휴무 (closed), and a Naver note says a branch is under construction and asks visitors to go to another location. VisitSeoul/VisitKorea still list 29 Myeongdong 10-gil. Check Naver Map for which building is open before going.

gwangjang.text: Food alley daily 09:00-23:00 (year-round); main market shops 09:00-18:00, closed Sundays
gwangjang.closedDays: Main market (fabric/goods shops) and vintage shops closed Sundays; food alley open year-round
gwangjang.notes: Hours are for the food alley. Each stall sets its own hours and days off (e.g. some popular stalls close Mondays); guides report fewer stalls open on Sundays. Vintage shops 10:00-19:00, closed Sun.

namdaemun.text: Mon-Sat; VisitSeoul lists 00:00-23:00 on weekdays but hours vary by stall (most retail shops roughly daytime). Closed Sundays (most shops)
namdaemun.notes: Sunday closure is consistent across sources (some individual shops do open Sundays). Official listing gives 00:00-23:00 because of night wholesale trade; retail stalls typically keep daytime hours (one guide says ~09:00-17:00) - no single reliable retail time, so open/close left null. Plan a Mon-Sat daytime visit.

myeongdong.text: Shopping street open daily (store hours vary, typically ~10:00-22:00). Street-food stalls approx. late afternoon (~16:00-17:00) to ~22:00-23:00
myeongdong.notes: VisitSeoul only says 'Open daily (hours vary by store)' and gives no stall times. Stall times are from blogs and vary: start 15:00-17:00, end 22:00-23:00 (some later). open/close are approximate. Store-hours '~10:00-22:00' is a general estimate, not sourced officially.

mangwon.text: Daily approx. 10:00-21:00 per VisitSeoul (varies by store); other sources say 10:00-20:00
mangwon.closedDays: None market-wide per current listings (individual shops have own days off)
mangwon.notes: Sources conflict on closing time: VisitSeoul 10:00-21:00, Seoul Mediahub (Mar 2024) 10:00-20:00 연중무휴, go!Seoul newsletter 08:00-22:00. An older VisitSeoul tour page mentions closures on Tue & Sun but newer listings don't. closeTime set to the conservative 20:00. Market tel +82-2-335-3591.

gotomall.text: Official site: open every day 10:00-20:00 (tourism sites say 10:00-22:00); store hours vary
gotomall.closedDays: Official site says open year-round (연중무휴); VisitSeoul says closed on Seollal & Chuseok (not in trip window)
gotomall.notes: Conflict: official gotomall.kr lists '연중무휴 10:00 - 20:00'; VisitSeoul/VisitKorea list 10:00-22:00. Used the official 20:00 (conservative). No monthly holiday found. Tel 02-535-8182.

hongdae.text: No meaningful official hours - shopping street open daily, individual store hours vary
hongdae.notes: Skipped: no authoritative source gives hours for the street as a whole. It's a public street area; shops/clubs set their own hours.

bongeunsa.text: Grounds approx. daily 05:00-22:00 (most sources); one listing says 09:00-18:00

sources.label: VisitSeoul - Gangnam full of culture to history

bongeunsa.notes: VisitKorea main listing: 05:00-22:00, open all year. Conflict: the VisitSeoul attraction page says hours depend on temple services and also shows an old 'Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00'; a VisitKorea accessibility page says 09:00-18:00 (likely office/facility hours). Free entry. Daytime visit is safe either way. Official site bongeunsa.org was unreachable; tel +82-2-3218-4800.

seoul-museum-of-history.text: Tue-Sun 09:00-18:00 (last entry 17:30); Friday likely until 21:00; closed Mondays. Free
seoul-museum-of-history.closedDays: Mondays (unless a public holiday) and Jan 1
seoul-museum-of-history.notes: Mon 2026-11-30 = CLOSED (Monday closure verified). Unverified part is evening hours in Dec: the official page currently shows Tue/Wed/Fri/Sat/Sun 09:00-21:00 & Thu 09:00-18:00, but that is an 'expanded night opening' running 2026-09-15 to 11-30 only. Standard schedule per official/other sources is 09:00-18:00 with Fridays extended to 21:00 (since 2024-04-12) - expect that from Dec 1 but re-check the official page.

n-seoul-tower.text: Observatory Mon-Fri 10:00-22:30, Sat-Sun & holidays 10:00-23:00; last entry 30 min before closing. Adult 29,000 KRW
n-seoul-tower.closedDays: None (open year-round; may suspend in bad weather)
n-seoul-tower.notes: closeTime 22:30 is weekdays; Sat/Sun (Dec 5-6) close 23:00. Last entry ~22:00 weekdays / ~22:30 weekends. Admission: adult (13+) 29,000 KRW; child 3-12 & senior 65+ 23,000 KRW (official + VisitKorea). Older guides citing 21,000/26,000 KRW are outdated.
